# langfuse_blob_storage_integration (Resource)

Manages the scheduled blob storage export of a Langfuse project. A project has at most one integration, so its ID equals the project ID. Requires an organization-scoped API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "organization_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "organization_private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "export_secret_access_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "langfuse_blob_storage_integration" "example" {
  organization_public_key  = var.organization_public_key
  organization_private_key = var.organization_private_key
  project_id               = var.project_id

  type              = "S3"
  bucket_name       = "langfuse-exports"
  region            = "eu-central-1"
  access_key_id     = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE"
  secret_access_key = var.export_secret_access_key
  prefix            = "langfuse/"

  export_frequency = "daily"
  export_mode      = "FROM_TODAY"
  file_type        = "JSONL"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) The bucket (or container) to export to.
- `export_frequency` (String) How often data is exported: `every_20_minutes`, `hourly`, `daily`, or `weekly`.
- `export_mode` (String) Which data to export: `FULL_HISTORY`, `FROM_TODAY`, or `FROM_CUSTOM_DATE`.
- `file_type` (String) The export file format: `JSON`, `CSV`, `JSONL`, or `PARQUET`.
- `organization_private_key` (String, Sensitive) The organization private key used to authenticate API calls.
- `organization_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The organization public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project whose data is exported.
- `region` (String) The storage region.
- `type` (String) The storage type: `S3`, `S3_COMPATIBLE`, `AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE`, or `GOOGLE_CLOUD_STORAGE`.

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String) The access key ID used when `auth_type` is `ACCESS_KEYS`.
- `auth_type` (String) The authentication type: `ACCESS_KEYS` (default) or `ROLE_ARN`.
- `compressed` (Boolean) Whether exported files are compressed. Defaults to `true`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the export is active. Defaults to `true`.
- `endpoint` (String) The storage endpoint URL. Required for `S3_COMPATIBLE` and `AZURE_BLOB_STORAGE`.
- `export_field_groups` (Set of String) The field groups to include in the export. Defaults to the server default. Setting it requires `export_source`.
- `export_source` (String) The data source to export: `LEGACY_TRACES_OBSERVATIONS`, `OBSERVATIONS_V2`, or `LEGACY_TRACES_AND_ENRICHED_OBSERVATIONS`. Defaults to the server default.
- `export_start_date` (String) The RFC 3339 start date used when `export_mode` is `FROM_CUSTOM_DATE`.
- `force_path_style` (Boolean) Whether to use path-style bucket addressing. Defaults to `false`.
- `prefix` (String) The object key prefix for exported files. Defaults to an empty prefix.
- `role_arn` (String) The AWS role ARN to assume when `auth_type` is `ROLE_ARN`.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) The secret access key used when `auth_type` is `ACCESS_KEYS`. The API never returns it, so it cannot be imported and drift is not detected.

### Read-Only

- `external_id` (String) The external ID Langfuse presents when assuming `role_arn`.
- `id` (String) The integration ID, which equals the project ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langfuse_blob_storage_integration.example "${ORGANIZATION_PUBLIC_KEY}:${ORGANIZATION_PRIVATE_KEY}:${PROJECT_ID}"
```
